scientific_integrity: Finite enumeration and numeric Riemann checks are corroboration, not substitutes for the martingale central limit theorem. Fixed-parameter leaf mean, leaf CLT, marginal branch CLT, and the mean-implied finite covariance are acknowledged as existing or elementary work.
scientific_limitations: Proof assumes theta_n/n tends to c in (0,infinity). No boundary-scaling or uniform-rate claim. Independent historical-priority verification and scientific audit are outstanding.
title: Joint Gaussian law for root branches and leaves of linearly biased Hoppe trees
